tenderSchedule.title: Procurement of 3000 KL of HFO
tenderSchedule.description: Procurement of 3000 KL of HFO through Railway BTPN wagons for Bellary Thermal Power Station for the year 2026-27
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Chief Engineer (FM) Office BTPS Bellary

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall not have been subject to forfeiture of EMD / foreclosure / termination of their Contract in KPCL or Government or any other utility in the past three years or shall not have been blacklisted for participating in tender by KPCL or Government or any other utility in India during the past Three years (from the date of issue of NIT). Bidder shall furnish the notarized declaration in this regard as specified in Annexure-3.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The bidder should have PAN, GST and other statutory requirements and shall submit documentary evidence for the same.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have successfully supplied 1500 KL of HFO and to any Govt. Organizations/PSUs/ Public ltd. Company/ any Power Plant. In proof of the same, bidder shall submit the copy of purchase order in a single order or multiple orders in any one of the preceding five financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26) for qualifying.
The bidder should be a Reputed oil manufacturer and Supplier. Bidder shall submit documentary evidence for the same.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Reputed oil manufacturer and Supplier document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have annual turnover of Rs. 50.07 Crores in any two of the preceding five financial years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26. The bidder shall furnish a copy of P&L statement / audited balance sheet duly certified by a charted accountant to establish annual turnover requirement stipulated above.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
